lead: A class reference has no readable name: `$cls::class` is `E0702`.
body: A `class<T>` value is the run-time descriptor and `::class` needs a class named at compile time, so `nvs-cli` reports *"this names no class the compiler can resolve"* and points at `Core\Reflect` (`rule:classes/no-free-functions-or-constants`). A `.nvst` case that wants to show which class was selected calls an overridden member and reads the answer, as the class-reference cases under `tests/conformance/class/` do.
